what: rOEference: Easy Access to Some Flemish Reference and Heritage Datasets
title: rOEference: Easy Access to Some Flemish Reference and Heritage Datasets
text: package provides helper functions download load Flemish public (geographic) reference datasets administrative units, well public geographic datasets Flemish Heritage agency (agentschap Onroerend Erfgoed).

title: rOEference: Easy Access to Some Flemish Reference and Heritage Datasets
text: ’re still working first CRAN releas, can install development version roeference using devtools:

title: rOEference: Easy Access to Some Flemish Reference and Heritage Datasets
text: package contains several functions downloading specific reference datasets: functions provided package take care downloading extracting data. return dataframe like object (DataFrame, Tibble, Simple Features object). can directly used analysis plotting.
code: library(roeference)  # Get a Simple Features object containing the Flemish municipalities and # their boundaries municipalities <- get_vrbg_sf()  # Get a Simple Features object containing the Flemish municipalities and # their boundaries provinces <- get_vrbg_sf(collection = "Refprv")  # Get a Simple Features object containing the protected archaeological # sites in Flanders and their boundaries protected_arch_sites <- get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten(layer = "bes_arch_site") library(ggplot2) library(sf) #> Linking to GEOS 3.14.1, GDAL 3.12.2, PROJ 9.7.1; sf_use_s2() is TRUE  p <- ggplot(protected_arch_sites) +   geom_sf(data = municipalities) +   geom_sf(fill = "red", alpha = 0.8) p

title: Function to add a variable with broader concepts to a dataframe — broaden_concept
text: `broaden_concept()` Given dataset wich containing column containing   Flanders Heritage concept URI's, function add column containing   nested data frame URI label concept broader   concepts. primary goal allow easy filtering specific   concepts URI Label taking narrower labels account   well. , dataset can either unnested using tidyr::unnest()   using filter_concept() function package.

title: Get Flanders Heritage Inventory designation objects (aanduidingsobjecten) — get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten
text: `get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten()` get OGC Simple Features collection containing designated heritage sites (protected sites inventorised immovable heritage). data downloaded https://geo.onroerenderfgoed./downloads.  coordinate reference system EPSG:31370.

title: Get Flanders Heritage Inventory designation objects (aanduidingsobjecten) — get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten
Get Flanders Heritage Inventory designation objects (aanduidingsobjecten) — get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten
text: layer layer returned downloaded zip file. Default value 'aanduidingsobjecten', containing types designation objects. values : aanduidingsobjecten_historiek Designation objects, including    designations longer valid. bes_arch_site Protected archaeological sites / Beschermde    archeologische sites bes_landschap Protected Landscape / Beschermd cultuurhistorische    landschappen bes_monument Protected Monument / Beschermd monumenten bes_overgangszone Transitional zone' / Overganszones bes_sd_gezicht Protected cityscape, / Beschermde stads-    dorpsgezichten erfgoedls Heritage landscape / Erfgoedlandschap gga Area archaeology expected / Gebieden waar    geen archeologie te verwachten valt unesco_kern UNESCO World Heritage site - core area / UNESCO    werelderfgoed - kernzones unesco_buffer UNESCO World Heritage site - buffer area / UNESCO    werelderfgoed - bufferzones vast_az Archaeological zone / Vastgestelde archeologische zone vast_be Architectural heritage / Vastgesteld bouwkundig erfgoed vast_la Landscape atlas / Vastgestelde landschapsatlas vast_le Landscape elements / Vastgestelde landschapselementen

Get reference datasets for administrative borders in Flanders — get_vrbg_sf
text: collection string representing collection (.e. type administrative unit) returned. Possible values default version reference data set : Refgemmunicipalities, default 'Refgew'Flemish region Refprvprovinces 'Refarr'arrondissements collection names case-sensitive. version string representing version reference file. Default 'VRBG', always recent version. specific versions also possible (e.g. 'VRBG2003'). Note versions contain collections. crs string representing EPSG code coordinate reference system. Default value 'EPSG:31370' Belgian Lambert 1972. likely values 'EPSG:4326' (WGS84), 'EPSG:3812' (Belgian Lambert 2008) 'EPSG:4258' (ETRS89). complete list supported reference systems, inspect collections endpoint.

title: Get supported CRS for administrative borders in Flanders — get_vrbg_supported_crs
text: `get_vrbg_supported_crs()` get character vector EPSG codes coordinate reference systems supported specific version Provisional Reference File Municipal Borders (Voorlopig Referentiebestand Gemeentegrenzen) published OGC Features API Flemish Government (see: metadata catalog entry)

title: Get supported CRS for administrative borders in Flanders — get_vrbg_supported_crs
Get supported CRS for administrative borders in Flanders — get_vrbg_supported_crs
text: version string representing version reference file. Default 'VRBG', always recent version. specific versions also possible (e.g. 'VRBG2003').

title: Get supported CRS for administrative borders in Flanders — get_vrbg_supported_crs
text: character vector containing EPSG codes format 'EPSG:<number>'.

title: Extract sf object from httr2 response object containing geojson — resp_sf_from_geojson
text: `resp_sf_from_geojson` function extracts Simple Features (sf) object httr2 response object response body contains feature set geojson format.

Extract sf object from httr2 response object containing geojson — resp_sf_from_geojson
text: resp httr2 response object annotated boolean value (default TRUE). TRUE, returned object contains metdadata (retrieval_url retrieval_time) object's comment.
